Calculate daily recording effort per site

Source: R/06_occupancy.R
pam_daily_effort.Rd

Splits recordings that cross midnight into two rows and sums hours per site per calendar day. Days below min_effort_h are flagged as insufficient.

Usage

pam_daily_effort(master, tz = "Asia/Kolkata", min_effort_h = 2)

Arguments

master

A data.table with columns site_id, start_time (POSIXct), duration_s, qc_pass, in_deployment.

tz

Character. Timezone for calendar dates.

min_effort_h

Numeric. Minimum recording hours for an occasion to count as surveyed.

Value

A data.table with columns site_id, occasion_date (Date), effort_hours, sufficient.
